summary.shortDescription: A tabless 21700 power cell rated by Reliance at 6Ah and 50A maximum continuous discharge.
summary.description: The RS60 is Reliance's exact 21700 power-series cell. The current product matrix lists 6Ah nominal capacity, at least 5C continuous discharge without the 80°C cutoff, and 50A maximum continuous discharge. Battery Mooch published an exact-model vaping test at 5850mAh.

sources.title: Bench Test Results: Reliance RS60 - 50A 5850mAh 21700
sources.limitations: Full exact-model report text was retrieved through the ECF feed and reviewed; the feed is a presentation of the original forum report.

claims.statement: Reliance's product matrix identifies INR21700-RS60 as an exact model in its RS power series.
Reliance lists 6Ah nominal capacity; the exact vaping test title reports 5850mAh.
Reliance lists 50A maximum continuous discharge, while the retrieved vaping report supports 30A continuous and treats 50A as temperature-limited.
The retrieved exact-model vaping report measured about 5850mAh, about 77°C at 30A to 2.5V, and considered 30A continuous reasonable.

safetyFindings.summary: The product matrix separates a no-cutoff continuous value from a maximum value, and the retrieved test supports 30A continuous while treating 50A as temperature-limited.
safetyFindings.runtimeImplication: Use 30A as the proposed runtime ceiling.
